lines.text: Hi, I'm Sally! Welcome to Modern Pink Paper. I'm going to show you what a day in the print room looks like, step by step.
Here's the good news first. Every order goes through the same steps. Learn them once, and you can do the whole job.
Step one. Start the day with a nozzle check. Each printer prints a little test pattern, so we know the ink is flowing.
If a line is missing, we run a cleaning, and then check again. It only takes a minute, and it saves us from bad prints later.
Step two. Grab your order bin and set it by your desk. Then open your orders on the computer.
Every file name tells you what to print. The number is how many. The last word is the style, or the envelope color.
Step three. Put the right paper in the printer. Cards go in the side printers, and envelopes go in the extra printer.
Step four. Always print ONE copy first. This is our quality and accuracy check.
Read every word. Check the names, the spelling, the colors, and the edges. If anything looks off, stop and fix it before you print the rest.
Step five. Looks good? Print the rest. Big orders go out in batches of about forty, so nothing jams.
While one printer works, don't just wait. Set up your next job, and keep the printers busy.
Step six. While it prints, get your envelopes ready. Count them out, in the right color, and put the rest back where they go.
Then print the return address on the envelopes. We call these R A jobs. Same number as the cards.
Step seven. When it's all printed, check every single sheet. Every one. Make sure everything is right, and looking great.
Step eight. Package it in the proper packaging. And always, always handle with care.
Step nine. Add the inserts. A branding card, a thank you card, and an accuracy card that shows who did the order.
Step ten. Put a branding sticker on every package. Then print the shipping label, and stick it on. Now it's ready to go!
And that's one order. Here's the secret. The whole day is just this, again and again.
Check the printers. Print one and check it. Print the rest, and do the envelopes. Check every sheet. Pack it, and label it. Then grab the next order, and do it all over.
On a busy day that can be a couple hundred print jobs. So take your time at first, get the steps right, and the speed will come.
You've got this. If you have any questions, just ask your team. We're happy to help!
